It is not 0/62, and its captures are not reused for V13. All 2881 originals remain byte-identical in the committed preservation bundle. Signed reviewed8 and heldout150 stay untouched.

## What changed

- A single completion UTC instant is sampled after action-file hashing. The existing 900 s deadline remains immutable; a hash crossing that deadline records an incomplete prefix.
- Academic-year evidence now retains exact original same-row Year-cell/header or adjacent same-container label provenance. Hidden/navigation/control evidence, conflicting containers and unresolved explicit header references are rejected. Real row headers require no invented value block. Other scope checks and default-off production flags remain unchanged.
- Provider 402/429 sticky STOP refuses both later source tools; first cause/counters and ordinary university-site HTTP behavior remain unchanged.
- Both arms use an exact dependency-only `.venv` cache in the existing GH job. Source SHA, runtime/image/interpreter/workspace and requirements bind the cache; no prefix restore, page/raw/credential cache, batching or provider change. Installed package names/versions and digest are recorded. Actual warm-cache improvement is not yet measured.
